Mun-RD: British Columbia Regional District and Municipal Population Estimates
RD = Regional District, R = Region, RDR = Regional District Unincorporated Area, IGD = Indian Government District,
CY = City, T = Town, VL = Village, DM = District Municipality, IM = Island Municipality, RGM = Regional Municipality.

Jumbo Glacier Mountain Resort Municipality has no population throughout the report period.
All figures correspond to municipal boundaries as of July 1st of the year stated.
